title: DemonTrainerFrame
wikitext: '''DemonTrainerFrame''' replaces the standard merchant window when speaking to demon trainers. making demon trainer interactions more intuitive and streamlined. == '''Installation''' == '''Manual Installation only''' # Go to the main page of the repository. # Click the '''<> Code''' dropdown and download the repository as a .zip. # Extract the .zip file, move the DemonTrainerFrame folder from inside the DemonTrainerFrame_v0.0.7 folder to your Interface/AddOns directory # Restart the game. '''Optional''': [https://github.com/refaim/TrainerSkills '''TrainerSkills'''] == Git Links == * [https://github.com/crazypoultry/Wow1.12.1_Addons_Collection '''(crazypoultry)'''] == Commands == {| class="fandom-table" !Command !Description |- |/dtf or /DemonTrainerFrame |Prints DemonTrainerFrame info into chat |- |/dtf buy |Toggles the buy button safe-mode on and off |- |/dtf reset |Resets saved data and internal state |} == Features == * Shows demon skills at demon trainers instead of the merchant window. * Summon an appropriate demon to update skills if unsure. * Greys out grimories you already own or have in inventory. == Preview == [[File:DTF.png|frameless|477x477px]] [[Category:Addon]]
